description: This file contains utility functions used throughout the SugarCRM-based application, including functions for name returning, language handling, user and group management, GUID generation, UI utilities, and database interactions. It appears to be part of the include/utils directory and provides foundational support functions for the CRM system.

classes.name: VTCacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class that provides caching mechanisms for module names, field info, and permission lists to optimize repeated database lookups.

methods.name: return_name
methods.description: Constructs a full name from first and last name columns in a row array, handling missing parts gracefully.

methods.name: get_languages
methods.description: Returns the list of supported languages.

methods.name: get_language_display
methods.description: Returns the display name of a language given its key.

methods.name: get_assigned_user_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the user assigned to a particular ID by looking it up in the user array.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: Retrieves an array of active users, with optional sharing restrictions, and caches the result for efficiency.

methods.name: get_group_array
methods.description: Retrieves an array of groups, respecting sharing restrictions, and caches the result.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for safe shell command execution and trims to a maximum length.

methods.name: safe_map
methods.description: Transfers request variables into object member variables if they are not already set or if always_copy is true.

methods.name: safe_map_named
methods.description: Transfers a specific request variable into an object member variable, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: return_app_list_strings_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for application lists for the specified language, with fallback.

methods.name: return_app_currency_strings_language
methods.description: Loads currency strings for the specified language, with fallback.

methods.name: return_application_language
methods.description: Loads general application language strings, with optional translation prefix.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Loads language strings specific to a module.

methods.name: return_specified_module_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for a specified module without caching.

methods.name: return_mod_list_strings_language
methods.description: Loads list strings for a module-specific application list.

methods.name: return_theme_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for a given theme.

methods.name: return_session_value_or_default
methods.description: Returns a session variable’s value or a default if not set.

methods.name: append_where_clause
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to a list of conditions based on $_REQUEST variables.

methods.name: generate_where_statement
methods.description: Combines multiple WHERE conditions into a single SQL string.

methods.name: create_guid
methods.description: Generates a globally unique identifier (GUID).

methods.name: create_guid_section
methods.description: Generates a section of a GUID with a specified number of characters.

methods.name: ensure_length
methods.description: Pads or trims a string to a specific length.

methods.name: get_theme_display
methods.description: Returns the display name of a theme.

methods.name: get_themes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available themes.

methods.name: get_clear_form_js
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to clear all form fields.

methods.name: get_set_focus_js
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to set focus on specific form fields upon page load.

methods.name: array_csort
methods.description: Sorts a multi-dimensional array by multiple columns with specified flags.

methods.name: set_default_config
methods.description: Sets default global variables based on an input array if they are not already set.

methods.name: to_html
methods.description: Converts a string to safe HTML output, encoding characters based on context.

methods.name: getTabname
methods.description: Fetches the tab label for a given tab ID from the database.

methods.name: getTabModuleName
methods.description: Fetches the module name associated with a tab ID, using cache for performance.

methods.name: getColumnFields
methods.description: Retrieves the column fields for a given module, caching results.

methods.name: getUserEmail
methods.description: Returns the email of a user given their ID.

methods.name: getUserId_Ol
methods.description: Retrieves user ID by username (used for Outlook integration).

methods.name: getActionid
methods.description: Returns the action ID for a given action name, loading from cache or database.

methods.name: getActionname
methods.description: Returns the action name for a given action ID.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Gets user ID from an entity record.

methods.name: getRecordOwnerId
methods.description: Gets the owner (user or group) ID for a record.

methods.name: insertProfile2field
methods.description: Inserts profile-to-field mappings for a profile ID.

methods.name: insert_def_org_field
methods.description: Inserts default organization fields.

methods.name: getProfile2FieldList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of profile-to-field settings for a module profile.

methods.name: getProfile2FieldPermissionList
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for profile fields.

methods.name: getProfile2ModuleFieldPermissionList
methods.description: Retrieves field permissions for a profile and module.

methods.name: getProfile2AllFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves all profile-to-field permission data for multiple modules.

methods.name: getDefOrgFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves default organization fields for a module.

methods.name: getQuickCreate
methods.description: Checks if QuickCreate is permitted for a module/action.

methods.name: ChangeStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of an activity record.

methods.name: getUnitPrice
methods.description: Retrieves unit price for a product/service.

methods.name: upload_product_image_file
methods.description: Handles uploading an image file for a product.

methods.name: getProductImageName
methods.description: Retrieves image names for a product and manages deletions.

methods.name: getContactImageName
methods.description: Retrieves contact image filename.

methods.name: updateSubTotal
methods.description: Updates subtotal and total in inventory data.

methods.name: getInventoryTotal
methods.description: Calculates total inventory value for a record.

methods.name: updateProductQty
methods.description: Updates product stock quantity.

methods.name: get_account_info
methods.description: Retrieves account information related to a potential.

methods.name: get_quickcreate_form
methods.description: Returns HTML for a quick create form field based on label and type.
